"Idle RPG action-idle mobile RPG centered around auto firing, consuming, and absorbing enemies to permanently gain power.  
​Hook @COMMENT_BODY@ Devour Mechanics: Players auto-aim a chain hook to drag monsters, aliens, and bosses toward their character. Defeating and devouring these targets converts them into XP and resources to fuel growth.  
​Permanent RPG Progression: Every consumed enemy provides permanent stat upgrades to attack power, speed, health, crit, health regen,  and armor. Players can tailor their build into a high-damage glass cannon or a tanky survivor.  
​Gear @COMMENT_BODY@ Skill Trees: Players unlock loadouts, collect equipment, open resource chests, and invest in passive skill systems like the Soul Tree and Soul Graph.  
​Game Modes @COMMENT_BODY@ Content: Includes single-player campaign zones, endless progression via the Boss Tower, event bosses 
​Idle @COMMENT_BODY@ Offline Features: Supports offline single-player mode alongside optional auto-battle and AFK (away-from-keyboard) progression to keep upgrading while inactive. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
